#Problem 1
```{r}
#install.packages('dplyr')
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```
```{r}
tibble_2021_full <- read_delim("/Users/manideeppendyala/Downloads/scimagojr 2021  Subject Category - Statistics and Probability.csv", 
                          delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE)

tibble_2022_full <- read_delim("/Users/manideeppendyala/Downloads/scimagojr 2022  Subject Category - Statistics and Probability.csv", 
                          delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE)

tibble_2023_full <- read_delim("/Users/manideeppendyala/Downloads/scimagojr 2023  Subject Category - Statistics and Probability.csv", 
                          delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE)
```
#Part 1a
```{r}
tibble_2022 <- tibble_2022_full %>% select(Publisher, `Total Docs. (2022)`) %>%
  rename(Num_Documents = `Total Docs. (2022)`) %>%
  mutate(Year = 2022)

tibble_2023 <- tibble_2023_full %>% select(Publisher, `Total Docs. (2023)`) %>%
  rename(Num_Documents = `Total Docs. (2023)`) %>%
  mutate(Year = 2023)
```

```{r}
tibble_2022and2023 <- bind_rows(tibble_2022, tibble_2023)
```

```{r}
top_three_publishers <- tibble_2022and2023 %>%
  group_by(Publisher) %>%
  summarise(Total_Docs = sum(Num_Documents, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Docs)) %>%
  slice(1:3)
```
```{r}
write_csv(top_three_publishers, "/Users/manideeppendyala/Downloads/top_three_publishers.csv")
```

#Part 1b
```{r}
tibble_top_publishers <- bind_rows(
  tibble_2022_full %>% select(Region, Publisher, `Total Docs. (2022)`) %>% 
    rename(Num_Documents = `Total Docs. (2022)`) %>% 
    mutate(Year = 2022),
  
  tibble_2023_full %>% select(Region, Publisher, `Total Docs. (2023)`) %>% 
    rename(Num_Documents = `Total Docs. (2023)`) %>% 
    mutate(Year = 2023)
) %>%
  filter(Publisher %in% top_three_publishers$Publisher) %>%
  select(Region, Publisher, Year, Num_Documents)

```
```{r}
write_csv(tibble_top_publishers, "/Users/manideeppendyala/Downloads/top_publishers_dataset.csv")
```

#Part 2
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

links <- list(
  "2021" = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StevensonBolivar/MSDS2025/main/HW2/Total_Documents_Top3_2021.csv",
  "2022" = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StevensonBolivar/MSDS2025/main/HW2/Total_Documents_Top3_2022.csv",
  "2023" = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StevensonBolivar/MSDS2025/main/HW2/Total_Documents_Top3_2023.csv"
)

df_list <- map(names(links), ~ {
  read_csv2(links[[.x]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Publisher, names_to = "Region", values_to = "Number_of_Docs") %>%
    mutate(Year = as.integer(.x))  
})

cleaned_df <- bind_rows(df_list) %>%
  select(Year, Region, Publisher, Number_of_Docs) 

write_csv(cleaned_df, "full cleaned data.csv")

print(cleaned_df)
```

print(docs_year)

#Problem 2
#Part 1
```{r}
#install.packages('Lahman')
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```
```{r}
people_tibble_bn <- People %>%
  select(birthYear, nameFirst) %>%
  drop_na(birthYear, nameFirst) %>% 
  group_by(birthYear, nameFirst) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%  
  arrange(birthYear, nameFirst) 

print(people_tibble_bn)
```
#Part 2

```{r}
players_tibble <- Fielding %>%
  group_by(playerID) %>%
  summarise(total_of_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(People %>% select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast, nameGiven), by = "playerID") %>%
  select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast, nameGiven, total_of_games) 

print(players_tibble, n=10)
```
#Part 3

```{r}
players_tibble_two <- players_tibble %>%
  mutate(full_name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast)) %>%
  select(playerID, full_name, nameGiven, total_of_games) 

print(players_tibble_two)
```
#Part 4

```{r}
top_five <- players_tibble %>%
  filter(total_of_games >= 500) %>%
  group_by(nameFirst) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(count)) %>%
  slice(1:5)

print(top_five)
```
#Problem 3
#Part 1

```{r}
#install.packages('nycflights13')
#install.packages('ggplot2')
library(nycflights13)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
monthly_delays <- flights %>%
  group_by(month, origin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_delays$month <- factor(monthly_delays$month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.name)

ggplot(monthly_delays, aes(x = month, y = mean_dep_delay, color = origin, group = origin)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_dep_delay - 2 * se, ymax = mean_dep_delay + 2 * se, fill = origin), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) + 
  labs(
    title = "Average Departure Delay by Month",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Departure Delay",
    color = "Origin",
    fill = "Origin"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 
```
#Part 2

```{r}
flights_filtered <- flights %>%
  filter(arr_delay <= mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE) + 2 * sd(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(flights_filtered, aes(x = distance, y = arr_delay, color = origin)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +  
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) + 
  scale_x_log10() +  
  labs(
    title = "Flight Distance vs. Arrival Delay",
    x = "Flight Distance (miles, log scale)",
    y = "Arrival Delay (minutes)",
    color = "Origin Airport"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 
```

#Part 3
```{r}
sep12_flights <- flights %>%
  filter(month == 9, day == 12)

ggplot(sep12_flights, aes(x = dep_delay, y = arr_delay, color = origin)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +  
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 1) +  
  labs(
    title = "Arrival Delay vs. Departure Delay on September 12, 2013",
    x = "Departure Delay (minutes)",
    y = "Arrival Delay (minutes)",
    color = "Departure Airport"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("EWR" = "red", "JFK" = "blue", "LGA" = "green"),
                     labels = c("EWR" = "Newark", "JFK" = "Kennedy", "LGA" = "La Guardia")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

#Part 4
```{r}
carrier_delays <- flights %>%
  group_by(carrier) %>%
  summarise(mean_arr_delay = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_arr_delay))  

ggplot(carrier_delays, aes(x = reorder(carrier, mean_arr_delay), y = mean_arr_delay, fill = carrier)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  coord_flip() +  
  labs(
    title = "Mean Arrival Delays for different Carrier",
    x = "Carrier",
    y = "Mean Arrival Delay "
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

#Problem 4 
```{r}
library(gapminder)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

```
#Part 1
```{r}
gapminder_2007 <- gapminder %>% filter(year == 2007)

scatter_plot <- ggplot(gapminder_2007, aes(x = log10(gdpPercap), y = lifeExp, color = continent, size = pop)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "GDP per Capita vs. Life Expectancy",
    x = "GDP per capita (log)",
    y = "Life Expectancy"
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 15)) + guides(size = "none") +
  theme_minimal()
print(scatter_plot)
```
#Part 2
```{r}
library(gapminder)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

gapminder_2007 <- gapminder %>% filter(year == 2007)

gapminder_2007_filtered <- gapminder_2007 %>% filter(lifeExp > 75)

scatter_two <- ggplot(gapminder_2007_filtered, aes(x = log10(gdpPercap), y = lifeExp, color = continent, size = pop)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +  
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +  
  geom_text(data = gapminder_2007_filtered %>% filter(pop > 35000000),
            aes(label = country), vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 4) +  
  labs(
    title = "GDP per Capita vs. Life Expectancy (>75 years, 2007)",
    x = "GDP (per capita, log scale)",
    y = "Life Expectancy"
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 15)) + guides(size = "none") +
  theme_minimal()

print(scatter_two)
```
#Part 3
```{r}
#install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
scatter_plot + scatter_two
```
